blocks.heading: Core Zones (1–5) vs Buffer Gates (6–10)
blocks.intro: Understanding the ecological diversity between historical lake basins and rugged buffer hills.

items.title: Core Zones (Gates 1 to 5)
items.text: Covers the historical heart of Ranthambore featuring ancient Chauhan dynasty ruins, Banyan trees, Padam Talao, Rajbagh Lake, and Malik Lake. Highest prey concentration of Sambar and spotted deer with world-famous waterbody tiger sightings.

items.title: Buffer Zones (Gates 6 to 10)
items.text: Surrounding woodlands including Sawai Mansingh Sanctuary and Chambal corridors. Dramatic escarpments, deep ravines, and high leopard density. Far less vehicular congestion, providing peaceful birdwatching and elusive big cat tracking.

blocks.title: Official Zone Allotment Notice
blocks.text: While we submit your zone preference (Zones 1-5 or 6-10), the final zone number is assigned through the Rajasthan Forest Department computerised lottery system on the day of the safari. Both core and buffer zones host thriving tiger populations.
